actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: The online backpack offer, urgency question, convenience/selection, total-cost and reliability checks and physical-shop alternative fit reflective consumption. However, the laptop's visible screen and keyboard face the audience while the apparent user is seated behind them, so she cannot see the shown offer from that position.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px shopper, online backpack offer, questioning/checking bubble and physical-shop alternative remain clear without reading detailed offer text.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px cost and reliability questions are open rather than guarantees; the user-device orientation defect is still clear.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The laptop's entire display front and keyboard are directed toward the audience; the shopper sits on the opposite side behind the display. This is not a plausible over-shoulder or correctly actor-facing screen.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

blockingFindings.description: Actual user is behind a laptop whose offer display and keyboard face the audience.
blockingFindings.targetedCorrection: Correct the actor/device arrangement, for example the same learner in an oblique over-shoulder position with display in front of her eyes. Preserve offer, urgency question, checks and physical-shop alternative.

interpretationLimits: Reliability remains a question rather than a verified safe shop. The image illustrates deliberation, not a mandatory online purchase or automatic refund.
